kjv: the vessels of the young men are holy, and the bread is in a manner common
mine: The vessels of the young men are holy even when it is an ordinary journey
note: wehu' derekh chol means "and it (the mission) is an ordinary journey". The KJV supplies "the bread". The Hebrew is difficult. KJV 21:5.

kjv: scrabbled on the doors of the gate
mine: made marks on the doors of the gate
note: wayetav (qere) means "made marks" (from taw, a mark). "Scrabbled" is obsolete. KJV 21:13.
